org: martynakr
service: wedding-rsvp-backend

provider:
    name: aws
    runtime: nodejs20.x
    region: ap-southeast-2
    httpApi:
        cors: true
        authorizers:
            customAuthorizer:
                type: request
                functionName: authorizer
                identitySource:
                    - $request.header.Cookie

functions:
    authorizer:
        handler: src/functions/auth/verifyToken.handler

    auth:
        handler: src/functions/auth/auth.handler
        events:
            - httpApi:
                  path: /auth
                  method: post

    invite:
        handler: src/functions/getInvite/getInvite.handler
        events:
            - httpApi:
                  path: /invites
                  method: get
                  authorizer:
                      name: customAuthorizer

    updateInvite:
        handler: src/functions/updateInvite/updateInvite.handler
        events:
            - httpApi:
                  path: /rsvp
                  method: post
                  authorizer:
                      name: customAuthorizer
